narrative:
The model determined that you have an 85% probability of representing a bad credit risk. This high likelihood led directly to the denial of your loan application.

The three factors that most strongly influenced this outcome were the size of the loan you requested, the length of time you wanted to repay it, and the current status of your checking account. 

Your requested loan amount of 15,672 DM was dramatically higher than the average of about 3,020 DM among applicants who were approved. This large sum pushed the prediction strongly toward bad credit risk. Similarly, the 48-month repayment period you asked for is more than twice as long as the typical 19 months seen in successful applications, which further increased the model's concern about your risk level. Finally, having a checking account balance between 0 and 200 DM also contributed to the negative decision, as most approved applicants (nearly 60%) maintain no checking account at all or hold stronger balances.

Taken together, these three elements created a clear picture of elevated risk in the model's assessment. 

To improve your chances in the future, consider applying for a substantially smaller loan with a shorter repayment term once your checking account shows a healthier balance. This combination would remove the main reasons behind the current rejection. (218 words)
